newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's OCAL launches T-bill fund.
newsitem.headline: Russia's OCAL launches T-bill fund.

text.p: Moscow investment management company Orion Capital Advisors Ltd (OCAL) has launched a $140 million fund specialising in the debt markets of Russia and other former Soviet republics, OCAL said.
The assets of Cayman Island-registered Orion Russia/NIS Debt Fund were subscribed by South Korean institutional investors including Samyang Merchant Bank, which sponsored the fund.

The fund, the second launched by privately owned OCAL, focuses on local debt of Russia and former Soviet republics, and also their offshore hard currency debt. The first fund, Orion Russia/NIS Opportunity Fund, launched in June last year, invests in equity as well as debt.
